uncertainty_scenarios.name: Base scenario

uncertainty_scenarios.name: Mixed slowdown

uncertainty_scenarios.description: A hidden local crack is added and all crack effects are recomputed from geometry.

uncertainty_scenarios.description: A hidden longer crack is added and all crack effects are recomputed from geometry.
